purpose: Teach: 売り込み/給水/消火/手掛け/綴る/祭祀/即位/レポーター

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、自分で、絶対、売り込み、絶対、行ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: From the very beginning, your father threw himself into it. He'd pitch the company himself, go door-to-door. He was utterly serious about it.
lines.style: Steady, measured delivery. Quiet pride in the memory. Slight weight on 「絶対」 moments—not laboring them, but letting them land. Voice of someone recalling a younger man's determination with deep respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、工場の、絶対、給水、絶対、整備、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Ever since my father's time, we've maintained the factory's water systems with complete dedication. I'm deeply grateful for that foundation.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Clear, deliberate pacing. Each phrase slightly measured—not stiff, but carrying the weight of inherited responsibility. Slight bow in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、消火、絶対、訓練、絶対、自ら、絶対、参加していたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father participated in fire drills himself. He was hands-on with the safety work. Absolutely committed to it.
lines.style: Quieter now, almost tender. Looking back further. Slight catch of emotion beneath the composure—the kind that comes with remembering someone's quiet diligence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、手掛けて、絶対、こられた、絶対、事業、絶対、私が、絶対、引き継ぎます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The business your father built and stewarded—I'm taking that forward. I'm carrying it with me.
lines.style: Slower pace. Almost ceremonial without being theatrical. Each word chosen with care. A son speaking to an elder about legacy. Voice steady but carrying quiet gravity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、日誌を、絶対、綴る、絶対、習慣、絶対、続けていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father kept a diary. Writing things down—it was his habit, his practice. He never stopped.
lines.style: Distant and close at once. Speaking as if to himself. Slight fade at the end, like the voice is trailing into memory. Respect woven through every phrase.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、地域の、絶対、祭祀、絶対、当社、絶対、参加してまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've participated in the local festivals and community events. That continuity matters deeply to me.
lines.style: Warmth surfaces here—genuine, not performed. Slightly slower. Voice opens a little, like he's sharing something personal. Still formal, but with visible care beneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さんの、本気で、絶対、社長、絶対、即位、絶対、お祝い、絶対、お得意様、絶対、たくさん来てくれたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: When your father became president, we held a celebration. So many valued clients and partners came to honor him.
lines.style: A smile in the voice—warm memory. Pacing picks up slightly with the life of that moment. Pride and nostalgia braided together. Voice glows with the recollection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。当時の、本気で、絶対、レポーター、絶対、お父さんの取材、絶対、絵になる方々、絶対、と、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I've heard the reporters at the time covered my father's tenure—captured photos with some truly distinguished people. It was quite a moment.
lines.style: Quieter closing. Dignified and complete. Slight satisfaction in the voice, like a circle closing. Words land with weight. The voice of someone who understands what his father built.
